notes.title: Welcome to Flatspace IIk v1.11
notes.content:
Hello Starpilots!

Another Flatspace IIk update today. Apart from small tweaks to the game engine, two notable changes are:
1. A fix for a bug which has been in the game since the beginning regarding shots or missiles in flight when the game is saved. These were not restored correctly upon load creating 'ghost' shots which remain forever. Now fixed.
2. A slight change to the aggression factor when attacking other ships, making them slightly less angry when accidentally shot. In Flatspace this number was damage*4, in Flatspace IIk it was damage*8. Now it is damage*6.

Happy Flying,

Mark

notes.title: Flatspace Updated
notes.content:
Greetings Starpilots!

Flatspace has had an upgrade and overhaul to match the capabilities of Flatspace IIk, and other new games like Gunstorm.

This is primarily an engine update, so there are no gameplay changes, but a lot has changed in the background, such as:
-New fonts, new lens flares, new starfield, and much better screen aspect support and improved graphics set-up.
-New separation of expert user options in Options.txt and game settings. Graveyard and settings are now stored in the Steam Cloud.
-Controls now support a full keyboard and (for future games!) 4 or more game controllers.

You'll notice a few things:
1. New fonts. The heading is less blurry and smaller on 16:9 screens, and the main font is better spaced.
2. New settings for expert users in Options.txt. There are two new options there: robustinit and fixaspect, plus fixes and upgrades to basic settings like screen resolution and timers.
3. Persistent settings and the graveyard are now backed up the Steam Cloud.
4. Better aspect-ratio support. The old 4:3 game is now transformed and looks largely the same at the 16:9 game. For other screens, the aspect can be fixed to stretch it if needed so that Flatspace should be playable on any shape or size of screen.
5. New starfield, new mouse pointer, new lens flares.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210780/Flatspace/

Mark

notes.title: Welcome to Flatspace IIk v1.09
notes.content:
Greetings Starpilots!

A busy month here working on my up-and-coming game Gunstorm. As a result, the Flatspace game engine has been upgraded, and Flatspace IIk has been updated to v1.09 today.

This is primarily an engine update, so there are no gameplay changes, but a lot has changed in the background, such as:
-Controls now support a full keyboard and (for future games!) 4 or more game controllers.
-A full 167 character-set in the fonts means that just about every European language is supported.

You'll notice a few things:
1. New fonts. The heading is less blurry and smaller on 16:9 screens, and the main font is better spaced.
2. Game settings are reset which means your first play will reset the Tutorial. Sorry about that, this is necessary because of the control code and filename changes.
3. Engine settings for expert users are now in Options.txt rather than Config.txt. There are two new options there: robustinit and fixaspect. See the Readme.txt for details.
4. Persistent settings and the graveyard are now backed up the Steam Cloud. Save games aren't at the moment because it can be useful to restore a back-up save, but it's easy to add at any point if desired.
5. Better aspect-ratio support. The old 4:3 game is now transformed and looks largely the same at the 16:9 game (although some text can be larger than some icons). For other screens, the aspect can be fixed to stretch it if needed, so that Flatspace should be playable on any shape or size of screen.
6. New starfield, new mouse pointer, new lens flares.

Finally, if you have the We Robot Music Pack, you'll find some new in-game music tracks there from We Robot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/585430/Flatspace_IIk/

Mark

notes.title: Taskforce Updated
notes.content:
Greetings Strategy Fans! Welcome to the first Taskforce update in over a year. Quite a few changes in this one...

FIRST! The campaign is now fully unlocked so you can play any mission in any order. This is quite a radical change but instantly improves the game. The original Amiga Taskforce from 1994, and Hilt II, both allowed any mission to be chosen. All of the training missions are available from the start too. Doing this avoids any worries or annoyances about losing campaign progress, and instantly adds a lot to the game for new buyers.

Secondly, Steam Achievements have been added, as current players will see in their Steam pages. There are lots of possibilities here, so there's an Achievement for completing each mission on each difficulty, and one for each training mission on Elite (some are harder than others!). There is an Achievement for completing the last mission and defeating Morgane (on any difficulty), but this is (ironically) easier than some of the others and will probably be superseded one day...

3. (I'll switch to numbers now): The Config.txt file is now loaded/saved to the game main folder rather than using the Windows 'Documents' folder, because Windows complains about security when looking in Documents. This shouldn't make any difference to players.

4. The screenwidth/screenheight/adapter options in the Config.txt now work, they didn't before, it was a bug. So you can at last set a custom screen mode.

And that's it apart from minor updates to the code. The demo includes the new features too. Thanks to the people who have bought the game in the past year, this update happened because of your sales. Find Taskforce here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291150/Taskforce_The_Mutants_of_October_Morgane/

Enjoy!

Mark

notes.title: New Radioactive Update and Demo Coming
notes.content:
Working on an update to Radioactive at the moment.

A new non-playable demo will be released on March 10th which will allow you to test the game on your system first (which is always useful), and show users what a game looks and plays like. It's remarkably fun to watch the computer play itself, and every game is different.

Mark

notes.title: Dev Update: New Taskforce Trailer
notes.content:
A new Taskforce trailer is now live, showcasing the new terrain graphics engine. There is also a second, longer trailer with extended gameplay, and a look at the equipment screen and some of the weapons you can choose from.

The manual is now online too, and full of details about the game if you want to know more. For the first time, the manual will be available as a full-colour printed book from Amazon. I think manuals and the background story to a game are so important. My favourite Microprose games from the 80s and 90s had fantastic manuals, maps and keyboard overlays which really enhanced the game.

Taskforce: The Mutants of October Morgane is due out on July 24th.

The Taskforce page is here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291150/Taskforce_The_Mutants_of_October_Morgane/

Mark

notes.title: Update in progress: v1.02
notes.content:
Flatspace IIk v1.02 in progress. A few small changes, not so much to the gameplay but to add more functionality:

-Better controller support. The Default Joy settings will default to a raft of controls on a XBox 360 controller.
-Much better loading times and Alt-Tab response.
-The ability to delete saved games.
-A few small bug fixes.

Should be ready by the end of the month.

Mark
